scripts.dev: npm run build:collections && node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && vite
scripts.build: npm run build:collections && npm run build:wasm && vite build && node scripts/build-offline.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build && cp cloudflare/pages/_worker.js cloudflare/pages/_routes.json cloudflare/pages/_headers dist/client/
scripts.test:wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm:contracts
scripts.test:collections: npm run build:collections && node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/collections-wasm.mts
scripts.storybook: npm run build:collections && node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-storybook-hints.mjs && storybook dev -p 6006 --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:collections && npm run build:wasm && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-storybook-hints.mjs && storybook build
